description: This file defines the ILifecycleParticipant interface in the Orleans framework, which allows objects to participate in lifecycle events by implementing the Participate method. It is a part of the lifecycle management abstractions.

classes.name: ILifecycleParticipant
classes.description: An interface that provides a hook for objects to participate in lifecycle events and signals that an object can take part in lifecycle management.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Adds the provided observer as a participant in the lifecycle.
